name: Raspberry Pi client
description: Raspberry Pi running the unified tesserae-device-pi client (dmellok/tesserae-device-pi) on a Pimoroni Inky panel. Pairs over REST with a claim code (MQTT and the cloud relay also work) and reports the panel it detected, so one kind covers every Inky model: a Spectra 6 Impression that advertises its gamut (canonically waveshare_e6) is served the panel-native 4-bpp .bin (packed on the server, painted with no Pi-side quantise), every other panel the PNG the Pi quantises itself. Mains-powered, so it can stay awake and pick a Send up within seconds.

sleep_interval_s.label: Sleep interval
sleep_interval_s.help: How long the client sleeps between frame fetches when polling via REST. MQTT-driven instances ignore this value (they wake on retained-frame publishes). Custom value is in seconds.

always_on.label: Stay awake
always_on.help: Keep polling on the awake interval below instead of sleeping between frames, so a Send, a schedule or a tap lands within seconds. A Pi is mains-powered, so this is on by default; turn it off for a Pi on a battery HAT.

awake_poll_s.label: Awake poll interval
awake_poll_s.help: How often to re-check for a new frame while staying awake. Ignored unless Stay awake is on. Unchanged content answers 304 without a panel refresh, so a short interval costs one small request rather than an e-paper repaint.

button_wake_s.label: Button wake window
button_wake_s.help: After a button press changes the page, stay awake this many seconds to catch rapid repeat presses before deep-sleeping, so scrolling several pages doesn't pay a fresh wake and Wi-Fi cycle per press. 0 sleeps immediately (best battery). Applies only to button wakes, not scheduled refreshes or rotation.

touch_enabled.label: Touch input
touch_enabled.help: For a Pi with a touchscreen: send taps on buttons, switches, sliders and steppers on the dashboard back to Tesserae.
